mapper.select: SELECT user_uid, user_email, user_pwd, user_role FROM qoo_member WHERE user_email = #{userEmail}
SELECT /* com.seinfo.protoA.component.main.mapper.LoginMapper.selectUserByEmail */ user_uid, user_email, user_pwd, user_role FROM qoo_member WHERE user_uid = #{userUid}

SELECT /* com.seinfo.protoA.component.main.mapper.LoginMapper.selectUsrInfo */ user_uid , user_email , user_nm , user_pwd , user_role , CASE WHEN user_pwd_ch_d is null then date_format(now(), '%Y-%m-%d') ELSE user_pwd_ch_d END AS user_pwd_ch_d , CASE WHEN user_login_d is null then date_format(now(), '%Y-%m-%d') ELSE user_login_d END AS user_login_d , CASE WHEN fail_dt is null then DATE(now()) ELSE date(fail_dt) END AS fail_dt , 'Y' AS use_yn , user_pwd_init_yn , fail_cnt , CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, IFNULL(fail_dt, DATE_SUB(now(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)), now()) >= 30 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS un_locking /* 30분 경과시 계정잠금해제 : 'Y' */ , (30 - TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, IFNULL(fail_dt, now()), now())) as waiting_time FROM qoo_member WHERE user_email = #{userEmail}
mapper.update: update /* com.seinfo.protoA.component.main.mapper.LoginMapper.updateUsrLoginSuccess */ qoo_member set fail_cnt = 0 , fail_dt = null , user_login_d = now() , mod_dt = now() , mod_user_id = #{userEmail} where user_uid = #{userUid}
